ms.promise:
・By the end of this month, we will have listed and analyzed all possible improvements that can be made from LBE V1. 
・We will collaborate with projects already interested in leveraging the LBE V2 to understand their needs and design the new, improved Version. 
・﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿We will commence development of the Aiken Smart Contract.

**Reviewer please note: the work necessary for this Proposal commences in February 2024! The timeline of events has not changed and is the same as in the Ideascale Proposal, as described in the rest of the Milestones. The work for Proposal will start later, as the LBE V2 is only possible once the Minswap V2 is complete. An email has been sent to catalyst@iohk.io explaining the situation.

・B) Qualitative Measures: Quality of the projects using the LBE V2, User Experience, User Feedback
